method: Two simultaneous independent SDK practice rooms on a private TypeScript Colyseus server; ordinary autopilot inputs at 30 Hz from 20 Hz authoritative snapshots, event level 3; no position, checkpoint or finish mutation. sampleMonitorNote: The exploratory stalled flag counted an already finished Lagon while Sky was still racing; it is excluded from this report. Neither race actually stalled.
artifactScope: Local private SDK diagnostic, not Docker or public-tunnel validation.
